queries: Cursor March 2026 Pro Plus $60 $70 Ultra $200 $400 included usage

sources_considered.why: Dated March 27 company support response states both subscription prices and included API usage allowances.
Read in full. January confirmation of guaranteed allowances was superseded for this assessment by the contemporaneous March response.
read_page returned a current documentation landing page, not the historical pricing text surfaced by search.

evidence_items.locator: Dean Rie, March 27, 2026, post 3, upgrade option
evidence_items.explanation: The stated allowances yield $10 of excess API-priced usage for a $60 fee and $200 for a $200 fee. This supports the approximate included-value reading, not a claim about Cursor's losses.

metric_scope.metric: Excess included API-priced usage value per subscription dollar on Pro+ and Ultra
metric_scope.units: USD of excess included usage per USD of monthly subscription fee

derived.formula: Pro+: (70 - 60) / 60 = 1/6 USD per USD. Ultra: (400 - 200) / 200 = 1 USD per USD.
derived.rounding: Pro+ equals 16⅔ cents per dollar, or 16.67 cents to two decimal places. The claimed 16 cents truncates downward; nearest-cent rounding would be 17 cents. Ultra is exact.

unresolved_gaps: Actual supplier costs and subscriber utilization are not established, so actual financial losses cannot be inferred.
